items.title: DJ Moore: Three catches in tough matchup
items.description:
Moore secured three of five targets for 25 yards and rushed once for 11 yards in the Bills' 23-6 win over the Vikings on Monday night.

items.title: Justin Jefferson: Highly inefficient sans Murray
items.description:
Jefferson brought in three of 11 targets for 58 yards in the Vikings' 23-6 loss to the Bills on Monday night.

items.title: Josh Allen: Survives Vikes D in win
items.description:
Allen completed 21 of 31 passes for 234 yards with one touchdown and one interception while adding six carries for 15 yards in the Bills' 23-6 win over the Vikings on Monday night.

items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson: Could miss time with knee tendon issue
items.description:
Stevenson (knee) is dealing with a knee tendon issue that isn't slated to require surgery but may require him to miss "a short period of time," Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
